name: comp-30
title: File Input
blurb: Styled HTML file input with label.
description: Native file input element wrapped with label and custom file picker button styling. Accepts any file type.
use_when: Simple, lightweight file selection without custom upload logic.
avoid_when: Drag-and-drop or preview; use specialized uploader components instead.
a11y: Native input with associated label via htmlFor. Standard keyboard and screen reader support.
